# Project: Codex Blockbench MCP
# Repository: https://github.com/XiaoNetwork-Astral/blockbench-mcp
# Upstream: https://github.com/jasonjgardner/blockbench-mcp-plugin
# Type: Blockbench desktop plugin with an in-process Streamable HTTP MCP server
# License: GPL-3.0-only

## Current state
- Package version: 1.7.0-codex.28.
- Install artifact: dist/codex_blockbench_mcp.js. The filename must match plugin id codex_blockbench_mcp.
- Default URL: http://127.0.0.1:3000/bb-mcp.
- Bearer authentication is enabled by default and the token is configured in Blockbench.
- Core catalog: 41 public tools. Optional Hytale catalog: 2 additional experimental public tools when the Hytale plugin is installed.
- Related operations are grouped by domain and read/write boundary. Invoke them with {"command":{"action":"<exact action>","input":{...}}}; each action retains its exact schema.
- Public names follow `<intent>_<domain>[_<facet>]`: `inspect_*` reads, `edit_*` changes model or editor state, `create_*` creates focused geometry, and `import_*`/`export_*` cross file boundaries.
- MCP prompts are bundled locally; the fork does not fetch behavior from the upstream prompt CDN.
- General resources cover projects, nodes, textures, validators, and optional integrations.

## Implemented capabilities
- Project open/duplication, Outliner, cube, mesh, armature, animation, Java display settings, texture, UV, paint, preview, import/export, material-instance, and history operations.
- Exact texture-pixel operations, selection-independent scoped texture application, guarded whole-texture removal, batch cube UV updates, spatial relationship inspection, and direct geometry measurement.
- Per-project audit history with filtering, pagination, guarded Undo/Redo, and manual-operation tracking.
- Logical client/session management, loopback-by-default networking, optional explicit network binding, and bearer authentication.
- Optional folder-scoped YSM workspace and protected reference/baseline/working-copy workflow.
- Optional Hytale tools, resources, and prompts.

## Non-negotiable modeling behavior
- Read and follow AGENTS.md before modeling. CLAUDE.md points to the same canonical workflow.
- Every created, duplicated, or moved Outliner node requires an explicit parent. Use the literal "root" only intentionally; never fall back to root when a parent is missing or ambiguous.
- Validate key attachments with world coordinates and front, side, top, and three-quarter views. Projection overlap is not proof of depth contact.
- Work in small reversible stages, re-read hierarchy/UUIDs/UVs, verify Undo consistency, and ask the user to inspect when structure or depth cannot be established reliably.
- Do not save over baselines, close unsaved tabs, delete experiments, package, or publish without explicit authorization.

## Security invariants
- Arbitrary JavaScript evaluation and generic action/click/dialog automation are permanently disabled.
- Mutating tools pass through project-role protection, audit recording, and bounded Undo cleanup. Read-only tools avoid full Undo-history scans.
- Names must resolve uniquely; duplicate display names require an exact UUID.
- Remote HTTP(S) geometry fetching is disabled; imports accept inline JSON, data URLs, or local JSON files.
- Secrets and bearer tokens must never be committed.

## Development
- Install: bun install
- Automated checks: bun run check
- Direct test command: bun test tests
- Prompts and API docs: bun run docs
- Production build: bun run build
- Contributor details: CONTRIBUTING.md
